en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Whoa...
This is even nicer than I thought it'd be.

Welcome to our magic show!
Whaddaya think? Isn't it divine!?

Yeah, it is... I didn't think you would have a real
stage set up. Did you and Himiko do all this?

No, no. This would've been impossible with
just two people. I got others to help us.

Kaito and Keebo helped carry equipment
from Himiko's research lab...

I designed the stage but Kirumi sewed the
curtains.

Everyone is so nice...
Atua deserves all the credit.

Ah...shouldn't everyone who worked
on it get the credit?

Oh, well, I didn't ask you to help because I
didn't know what you'd be useful for.
...Did you really have to say that?

Anyway, just sit tight. Once we're done
preparing, we'll start right away.
Done preparing? You're not ready yet?

The star of the show needs to settle her
nerves...

<CLT=cltMIND>The star of the show
requires mental preparations?
*shudder*...*tremble*...*quiver*
<CLT=cltMIND>She's shaking like a leaf!

Gonta so sorry about yesterday...
Gonta not know why he act that way...

Gonta too forceful... Still have long way
before Gonta call himself true gentleman.

I-It's not your fault... It's Kokichi's fault 
for tricking you.

Even so, I think you need to seriously
reflect on what you did!

Your gullible mind will eventually lead you
down the wrong path in life!
...Gonta be more careful next time.
So...what happened to Kokichi?

After Insect Meet and Greet, Kokichi's mouth
start to bubble, then he pass out...

Ah, I see...
He might not make it to the show, then.

Gonta so sorry about yesterday!
Gonta reflect on what happen!

Those fish in the tank above...
Are those truly...?
Is it alright to use something so dangerous?
This is quite a professional-looking set.

However, considering how unsettled Himiko
is...

We might not get to witness for ourselves
the skill of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
How unfortunate.

We managed to complete the preparations
in time. I hope everyone enjoys the show.

You helped out too, Kirumi?
Did you do the sewing?

You complete every task you're given, don't you?
No wonder you're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Maid<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

But right now, you're just an audience member
like everyone else. So let's enjoy the show.
Yes...I shall do just that.

Today, I will be a member of the audience
and enjoy this performance.
Himiko are you a bit...nervous?
J-J-J-Just a little bit!

<CLT=cltMIND>Certainly doesn't look like
just a little bit.

C-Cuz...the magic I'll be performing today is the
Extreme Water Magic, Underwater Escape Act.

I-I've never successfully cast it before...
It's pretty difficult, so I'm a little nervous.
You've never cast it before?

A-And...today...in order to raise 
the stakes...
There's a time limit...

If I don't escape from the tank within the time
limit, piranhas will be dropped in...
I'll be pureed.
Pureed!?
<CLT=cltMIND>This is looking a little dangerous...

<CLT=cltMIND>The water is cloudy, so I can't see very
clearly...but I do see fish swimming around.

<CLT=cltMIND>Those are all piranhas, huh?
They don't look like normal piranhas...

Those piranhas...were in my research lab.
Angie said we should use them for the show.
W-Wait, piranhas are way too dangerous...
Ah, Tenko...

Himiko, please reconsider! They're piranhas!
They're nothing like lasagna!

N-No need to worry. I'll instantly kill 
all the piranhas...with my magic.

You're going to kill them?
I thought this was an escape trick...
Himiko...are you serious?

There's...no way I can stop now.
Since Atua's watching the show and all.

There's no such thing as Atua!
Angie has brainwashed you!
You don't believe in my magic?
W-Well...

I can do it... I'm a skilled young girl...
Cuz...I'm a mage...

<CLT=cltMIND>She psyched herself up and headed
straight to the water tank.

O-Of course...I believe in your magic...
You're...my precious friend...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko...

Ready, Himiko? Did you say your prayers
and use the bathroom?
Nyeeeh... I said my prayers and went pee.

Nyahahahaha!
Then let's get the show started!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's starting already?
But not everyone is here yet...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki, Kokichi, Ryoma...and Kaito
aren't here...

<CLT=cltMIND>What happened to Kaito?
I thought he'd be here for sure...
<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if something happened...
Thank you, Atua, for being with us today.

Boo! Booooooo!!!
You're supposed to thank us first!

Nyahaha! I present to you the mysterious,
the miraculous, <CLT=cltSTRONG>The Amazing Himiko<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

N...Nyeh... Th-The magic I will perform 
today is the Extreme Water Magic...
U-U-Underwater...Escape Act...

If you would please turn your attention
to the water tank in front of you!

When the timer above the stage starts,
Himiko will enter the water tank.

Once she's in the tank, her assistant—me!—will
draw the curtain in front of the tank.
After 60 seconds have passed on the timer...

A separate, suspended tank will open and drop
in a <CLT=cltSTRONG>school of piranhas<CLT=cltNORMAL>! Oh my goodness!

After the piranhas have fallen, and the
curtain is opened...

If, by some miracle, Himiko has been gobbled
up, please give a big round of applause!
Juuuust kidding! It's a joke!

...I'm concerned about Himiko. She is not
responding properly to Angie's jokes.

Gonta worry...
Gonta have bad feeling...

Ughhh...Atua...!
Please protect Himi—

...Wait, what am I doing praying to Atua!?
That's Angie's schtick!
Well, I guess you could pray to some other god.

Nyeeeh... Well then, let's begin...
The Amazing Himiko's Magic Show!

<CLT=cltMIND>In her typical high-pitched voice, Himiko made
her announcement and started the timer.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then, she took a breath and
dove into the water tank!
<CLT=cltMIND>*splash!*
Okay! I'm closing the curtain!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie closed the curtains, obscuring
the water tank from view.
<CLT=cltMIND>We stared silently, waiting.

<CLT=cltMIND>I clenched my fists nervously,
my palms damp with sweat...
Himiko is still not out...
She went in mere moments ago.
W-Well, do you think she's alright?

Uhh... Gonta starting to worry.
Should we do something?

Sh-She still hasn't come out!
Are you sure she's okay!?
G-Gonta can't take it anymore!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta cried out, leaped out of
his seat, and...
Wait...Gonta!?
<CLT=cltMIND>ran up onto the stage!

Aw, you can't do that! We're still in
the middle of the show!

B-But...if Gonta do nothing, Himiko get
eaten by piranhas—
...Huh?
Um... Less than ten seconds remain...

I don't care if it ruins the trick, just come 
out! This stress is bad for my heart!
Himikooooooooo!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Right when the timer hit zero,
the buzzer went off...
<CLT=cltMIND>And then...

<CLT=cltMIND>The bottom of the suspended tank swung open,
and the murky water and shadowy shapes inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>fell straight into the water tank
Himiko was swimming in!
Huh? Huhhh?
Look! The piranhas!

H-Hurry! The curtains!
Open the curtains already!
Got it. I'm opening it now!
<CLT=cltMIND>When Angie pulled apart the curtains...
<CLT=cltMIND>we witnessed an unbelievable sight.

<CLT=cltMIND>It took a few moments for all
of us to even process it.

<CLT=cltMIND>But then again, perhaps we
weren't trying to process it.
<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps we didn't want to acknowledge it.
By the way, can I ask you something, Angie?
Hmmm, what?

U-Um... When you're alone with Himiko,
what do you guys talk about?
Oh, just normal things...

Food, sweets, our nails, and how to get
Atua's bath water at a discounted rate.
That last one's not normal at all!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie...can be quite the handful.
I wonder if Himiko can handle her...

This is way bigger than I thought.
I imagined a plain, everyday stage.

I guess all the thoughts in my 
plain old head are just plain...plain.
Tenko, you're trembling.

I've told you many times that Atua loves
all His creations.

What do you mean, all his creations!?
That's way too much love!

What about Monokuma, huh?
Does Atua love him, too?

Of course. So we must love Monokuma,
so that our love will reach him.
Shaddup already!

Robots can't feel love! They can't feel any
emotions at all!

And yet...I felt a strange pain in my chest
after you just said that...

Y'know, lately I've been havin' weird pains in
my joints in my lower body.
Isn't that...a symptom of gout?

Wh-What is this device...!? I've never seen
somethin' like this before...!

Hnghhh... I'm gettin' excited...
Really, really excited...!

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko was so nervous she was shaking...
Can she really pull off this show?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a ladder here...
I wonder if it was used to set up the show.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is a timer.

<CLT=cltMIND>Does that mean this magic trick
will have a time limit?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a huge curtain hanging here...
What kind of magic trick is this for?
<CLT=cltMIND>A water tank...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like there's fish inside.
Is this part of the trick too?
